overall: The AG resolved the complaint by informal action and found no Open Meeting Law violation: a Chair's communication with the non-member Town Administrator does not show a quorum deliberated outside a meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board Chair communicated outside a noticed meeting with the Town Administrator about a matter within the Board's jurisdiction in October 2014.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, even if true, these facts would not constitute a violation of the Open Meeting Law.
